name: Customer
definition: A party that buys fuel and other goods at gas stations and is billed in a single payment currency. Each customer is identified by a unique customers.CustomerID.
scope: Customer-level population, segmentation and currency analysis; also the owning entity of monthly consumption records and of transaction lines.

name: Customer Segment
definition: Classification of a customer into one of the business segments recorded in customers.Segment. The observed value domain is KAM, LAM and SME.
scope: Applies only to the customers table. Must not be confused with the identically named gasstations.Segment, whose value domain is disjoint from this one.

name: SME Customer
definition: The subset of customers whose customer_segment value is 'SME'. The construction workload refers to these customers as SMEs.
scope: Subset of the customer_segment value domain limited to the single value 'SME'; used when a question asks about small and medium enterprises.

name: Customer Payment Currency
definition: The currency in which a customer settles payments, recorded in customers.Currency. The observed value domain is CZK (Czech koruna) and EUR (euro).
scope: Applies only to the customers table. Describes the customer's billing currency; it is not a property of an individual transaction row or of a gas station location.

name: Currency Customer Ratio
definition: The relative size of one customer currency group against another, expressed as a count of customers in one currency divided by the count of customers in the other currency.
scope: Customer-population comparison across the customer_currency dimension.

name: Gas Station
definition: A retail fuel outlet where transactions take place, identified by a unique gasstations.GasStationID. Each station belongs to a chain, is located in a country and carries a station segment.
scope: Station-level population and location/segment analysis; also the owning entity of transaction lines.

name: Gas Station Segment
definition: Classification of a gas station into one of the market segments recorded in gasstations.Segment. The observed value domain is Discount, Noname, Other, Premium and Value for money.
scope: Applies only to the gasstations table. Questions mentioning 'premium' or 'discount' stations refer to this dimension, not to customer_segment.

name: Gas Station Country
definition: The country in which a gas station is located, recorded in gasstations.Country. The observed value domain is CZE (Czech Republic) and SVK (Slovakia).
scope: Applies only to the gasstations table. Geographic location of the station, not of the customer; the customers table carries no country attribute.

name: Gas Station Chain
definition: The retail chain or brand grouping that a gas station belongs to, recorded as gasstations.ChainID. Chain identifiers are opaque numeric codes.
scope: Groups stations into chains for brand-level aggregation; the database contains no separate chain name table.

name: Product
definition: An item that can be purchased in a transaction, identified by a unique products.ProductID and named by products.Description.
scope: Product catalogue used to label what was bought in a transaction line.

name: Product Description
definition: The human-readable product name stored in products.Description, expressed mostly in Czech. 591 product records carry 529 distinct descriptions.
scope: Use when a question asks for product names or descriptions rather than product identifiers.

name: Transaction
definition: A single purchase line recorded in transactions_1k, tying one date and time, one customer, one payment card, one gas station, one product, a purchased quantity and a paid price.
scope: Transaction-level fact table. The table is a 1000-row sample, so it does not represent the complete historical transaction activity of the business.

name: Transaction Date
definition: The calendar day on which a transaction took place, stored in transactions_1k.Date as a 'YYYY-MM-DD' text value.
scope: Day-level time dimension of the transaction table, covering only 2012-08-23 through 2012-08-26.

name: Transaction Time
definition: The time of day at which a transaction took place, stored in transactions_1k.Time as an 'HH:MM:SS' text value.
scope: Time-of-day filtering within a transaction day; used for hour-window questions.

name: Transaction Amount
definition: The quantity of the product purchased in a transaction line, stored in transactions_1k.Amount. It is a quantity, not a monetary value.
scope: Additive measure across transaction lines; must not be confused with the monetary price column.

name: Transaction Price
definition: The total monetary value paid for a transaction line, stored in transactions_1k.Price. It is already the line total for the recorded quantity, not a unit price.
scope: Additive monetary measure; summing it over a customer's lines gives that customer's spending.

name: Customer Total Spending
definition: The total monetary value a customer has paid across their transaction lines, obtained by aggregating the transaction price measure per customer.
scope: Customer-level monetary aggregate used to rank customers by spending.

name: Average Price per Unit
definition: The mean monetary value of one purchased unit for a customer, defined as the customer's total transaction price divided by the customer's total purchased amount.
scope: Aggregate customer-level ratio; because individual lines can carry a zero quantity, the ratio is only meaningful when computed over aggregated totals rather than per row.

name: Gas Consumption
definition: The volume of fuel consumed by a customer during one calendar month, stored in yearmonth.Consumption.
scope: Monthly per-customer consumption measure sourced from the yearmonth table; it is a separate record type from the transaction table and is not derived from transactions.

name: Year-Month Period
definition: The calendar month to which a consumption record belongs, stored in yearmonth.Date as a six-character 'YYYYMM' text value.
scope: Monthly time dimension for consumption analysis; the first four characters denote the year and the last two the month.
